title: 哥本哈根地鐵環狀線~Copenhagen Cityringen
focus: 環狀自動捷運循環班表與深層車站~Automated orbital metro cycles and deep stations
summary: 以哥本哈根環狀地鐵為背景，建立沒有一般端點折返的循環營運實驗。課程研究列車間距、局部停站延誤與車站人流如何沿環線傳遞，並連接地下施工變形、垂直交通和設備備援的驗證資料。~Use Copenhagen Cityringen to construct a circular-operation experiment without a normal terminal reversal at each end. Study how train spacing, local dwell delays and station passenger flow propagate around the loop. Connect the operating model to evidence from underground construction movement, vertical circulation and equipment backup, avoiding the assumption that removing a terminus removes every capacity constraint.
example: 整合原創算例：單元 1 得 fleet=32 trains；單元 2 得 capacity=17307.69 persons/hour；單元 3 得 dwell=25.02083 s。上述三個結果使用各單元明示的不同邊界，不能任意相加或視為實際工程實測值。以第一單元 cycle 的擾動測試，結果改為 35 trains；學徒需先比較單位、敏感度和假設，再決定是否要細化模型。以哥本哈根環狀地鐵為背景，建立沒有一般端點折返的循環營運實驗。課程研究列車間距、局部停站延誤與車站人流如何沿環線傳遞，並連接地下施工變形、垂直交通和設備備援的驗證資料。 最終交付應保留原始輸入、測點時間戳、誤差範圍與無法由簡化式證明的結論。~Integrated original exercise: unit 1 gives fleet=32 trains; unit 2 gives capacity=17307.69 persons/hour; unit 3 gives dwell=25.02083 s. These three results use different explicit boundaries and must not be added or presented as measurements of the real railway. Perturbing cycle in the first unit changes its result to 35 trains. Compare units, sensitivity and assumptions before deciding which model needs refinement. Use Copenhagen Cityringen to construct a circular-operation experiment without a normal terminal reversal at each end. Study how train spacing, local dwell delays and station passenger flow propagate around the loop. Connect the operating model to evidence from underground construction movement, vertical circulation and equipment backup, avoiding the assumption that removing a terminus removes every capacity constraint. The final submission should retain original inputs, measurement timestamps, uncertainty ranges and conclusions that the simplified expressions cannot establish.
history: 公開工程與出版時間線：2011 年：哥本哈根環狀地鐵進入建設施工階段；2019 年：哥本哈根環狀地鐵於九月開放旅客服務。這些事件由下列機構來源提供背景，不表示來源公開了本課程所有設計數據。以哥本哈根環狀地鐵為背景，建立沒有一般端點折返的循環營運實驗。課程研究列車間距、局部停站延誤與車站人流如何沿環線傳遞，並連接地下施工變形、垂直交通和設備備援的驗證資料。 本課程另以可靠度、可用度、可維修度與安全方法整理需求、證據和變更邊界；歷史年份屬可查證事項，數學模型的輸入則是明示的教學假設。~Public engineering and publication chronology: 2011: Construction work for Copenhagen Cityringen began; 2019: Copenhagen Cityringen opened to passengers in September. The institutional sources below establish this background; they do not imply publication of every design input in this course. Use Copenhagen Cityringen to construct a circular-operation experiment without a normal terminal reversal at each end. Study how train spacing, local dwell delays and station passenger flow propagate around the loop. Connect the operating model to evidence from underground construction movement, vertical circulation and equipment backup, avoiding the assumption that removing a terminus removes every capacity constraint. The course separately uses reliability, availability, maintainability and safety reasoning to organise requirements, evidence and change boundaries. Historical dates are verifiable facts, whereas numerical model inputs are explicitly declared teaching assumptions.

units.anchor: 單圈週期與車隊需求~Loop cycle and fleet requirement
units.title: 單圈週期與車隊需求~Loop cycle and fleet requirement
units.mechanism: 環狀路線的循環時間是一圈行駛時間加沿途停站時間，不需要假設每圈都在端點換向。以循環時間除以班距並向上取整，可得到維持規則發車的最低運轉車數；如果某站停站延誤，車距不均會沿環線傳播，不能靠沒有終端站就宣稱沒有瓶頸。 循環時間除以班距後必須向上取整，半列車不能提供完整班次。此數量是投入循環的最低值，維修備用、延誤緩衝與不同分支運轉仍需額外配置。 用單圈時間取代雙端折返循環，計算環線所需列車數。~For a circular route, cycle time is one loop of running and station dwell; reversal at a terminal is not required on every circuit. Dividing cycle time by headway and rounding up gives the minimum circulating fleet for regular departures. Delay at one station can propagate uneven spacing around the loop, so absence of a terminus does not imply absence of bottlenecks. Divide cycle time by headway and round upward because a fraction of a train cannot provide a full departure. This is the minimum circulating requirement; maintenance spares, delay buffers and branch-specific operation need additional allocation. Use loop time instead of a two-terminal cycle to calculate trains required on the ring.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：cycle=5616 s; headway=180 s；計算：fleet=ceil(cycle/headway)=32 trains。敏感度：cycle 單獨增加百分之十至 6177.6 s，其餘固定，結果為 35 trains。模型邊界：固定周轉與班距、無延誤；不含備用率和維修排程。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: cycle=5616 s; headway=180 s; calculation: fleet=ceil(cycle/headway)=32 trains. Sensitivity: cycle, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 6177.6 s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 35 trains. Model boundary: Fixed cycle and headway without delays; reserve ratio and maintenance scheduling are excluded.
units.verify: 以同一列車通過固定參考站兩次的時間差量測單圈週期，逐站記錄停站時間，再重播連續數圈班表，確認每次發車有可用車組。若延誤持續累積，應分辨新增車輛、調節停站或進出車場安排的不同效果。 核對單圈行駛、沿途停站與班距使用相同時間單位，以逐列事件表確認每圈都有可用列車。~Measure loop time between two successive passages of the same train at a fixed reference station. Record dwell at each stop, then replay several circuits to confirm a train is available at every departure. If delay accumulates, distinguish the effects of extra trains, dwell regulation and depot entry or exit. Verify common time units for loop running, station dwell and headway, using a train-by-train event table to confirm availability on every circuit.
units.failure: 列車數足夠仍可能因機廠出入路徑受限而無法準時上線；忽略維修週期則會讓紙上車隊數不可持續。 循環時間稍增可能跨過整數門檻，不能只比較百分比。~Sufficient fleet count may still fail when depot access restricts insertion; ignoring maintenance cycles makes the paper fleet unsustainable. A small cycle-time increase can cross an integer fleet threshold; percentages alone are insufficient.
units.misconception: 環狀線沒有終端折返就不必核對單圈時間與車組數~A circular line without terminal reversal need not check loop time against fleet size.
units.practice: 增加一個轉乘站的停站時間並重算單圈週期與向上取整車數，再以逐列時刻表檢查車距不均是否沿環線擴大。另列維修備車，不能把最低運轉車數當成全車隊採購量。 再以本單元 cycle 的對照值重算 fleet，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Increase dwell at one interchange and recalculate loop time and the upward-rounded train requirement. Replay individual trains to check whether uneven spacing grows around the circle. List maintenance spares separately, rather than treating the minimum circulating count as total fleet procurement. Also recalculate fleet for the alternative cycle value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 班距與有效運能~Headway and usable capacity
units.title: 班距與有效運能~Headway and usable capacity
units.mechanism: 每小時運能由列車可用容量與通過頻率共同決定，平均班距縮短不代表每個車站都能吸收人流。車門交換、轉乘尖峰與不均勻到站會讓理論運能無法實現，容量計算應同時報告負載分布。 此式計算的是通過指定斷面的名目服務率，不能表示月台能容納多少人。需求在空間或時間上集中時，某站可以過載，即使整條線的平均載客率仍低。 把環線某站延誤後的實際班距逐班記錄，檢查運能。~Hourly capacity combines usable train capacity with passage frequency. A shorter average headway does not ensure every station can absorb the passenger flow. Door exchange, transfer surges and irregular arrivals can prevent the theoretical rate from being realised, so occupancy distribution must accompany the capacity estimate. This expression estimates a nominal service rate across a specified section, not how many people a platform can hold. Concentrated demand can overload one station even when average occupancy across the complete line remains relatively low. Record successive headways after delay at one loop station and inspect delivered capacity.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：people=900 persons/train; headway=187.2 s/train；計算：capacity=3600*people/headway=17307.69 persons/hour。敏感度：headway 單獨增加百分之十至 205.92 s/train，其餘固定，結果為 15734.27 persons/hour。模型邊界：固定班距且每列都能使用指定容量；不包含站台壅塞及服務波動。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: people=900 persons/train; headway=187.2 s/train; calculation: capacity=3600*people/headway=17307.69 persons/hour. Sensitivity: headway, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 205.92 s/train, with all other inputs fixed, gives 15734.27 persons/hour. Model boundary: Fixed headway with the stated usable capacity on every train; platform congestion and service variability are excluded.
units.verify: 以連續列車的實際到站時間與逐車廂乘載量重算，將未登車人數保留在隊列，不以列車額定容量代替實際服務量。 逐列核對上車、下車與留下人數的守恆，並以同一計數時間窗比較需求和服務量。~Recalculate from consecutive arrival times and individual car loads. Carry passengers unable to board into the queue instead of treating rated capacity as delivered service. Check conservation of boarding, alighting and remaining passengers for every train, using identical counting windows for demand and delivered service.
units.failure: 某一列延誤會使後車追近而前方隊列累積；只看小時平均會漏掉最擁擠列車與長等待尾端。 應查驗未登車隊列，避免把滿載通過當成需求已服務。~A delayed train lets following trains bunch while the upstream queue grows; an hourly mean hides both the fullest train and the long-wait tail. Inspect passengers left behind instead of interpreting a full passing train as demand served.
units.misconception: 只要平均班距減半所有乘客的等待時間就一定減半~Halving average headway necessarily halves the waiting time of every passenger.
units.practice: 用一組規則班距與一組相同平均值的不規則班距，追蹤每班留下的人數，解釋理論容量與可用容量的差距。 再以本單元 headway 的對照值重算 capacity，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Compare regular and irregular headways with the same mean, track passengers left behind after each departure, and explain the gap between theoretical and usable capacity. Also recalculate capacity for the alternative headway value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 車門交換與停站時間~Door exchange and dwell time
units.title: 車門交換與停站時間~Door exchange and dwell time
units.mechanism: 停站時間由車門開關、旅客交換與確認安全三部分組成。把旅客平均分到所有車門只是基準，樓梯位置會使某幾扇門超載；最慢的門組可能控制全列發車，因此不能只用平均流率。 均分模型是檢查單位和量級的起點；真實發車須等最後必要門組完成。上車和下車方向互相干擾時，應用分階段或逐門事件模型重新識別流率。 比較環線各站不均勻交換需求對最大停站時間的控制。~Dwell time comprises door movement, passenger exchange and confirmation before departure. Equal distribution across doors is only a baseline: stair placement can overload selected doors. The slowest door group may govern departure of the entire train, so average flow alone is insufficient. Uniform allocation is a starting point for units and scale, while actual departure waits for the last required door group. If boarding and alighting interfere, use phased or door-by-door event models to identify the relevant exchange rates. Compare how uneven station exchange demand controls the longest dwell around the loop.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：exchange=250 persons; doors=24 doors; rate=0.8 persons/(door*s); fixed=12 s；計算：dwell=exchange/(doors*rate)+fixed=25.02083 s。敏感度：exchange 將整數計數增加到 275至 275 persons，其餘固定，結果為 26.32292 s。模型邊界：均勻分配旅客與固定單門流率；不含對向人流衝突。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: exchange=250 persons; doors=24 doors; rate=0.8 persons/(door*s); fixed=12 s; calculation: dwell=exchange/(doors*rate)+fixed=25.02083 s. Sensitivity: exchange, increase the integer count to 275, to 275 persons, with all other inputs fixed, gives 26.32292 s. Model boundary: Uniform passenger distribution and fixed per-door flow; opposing-flow conflicts are excluded.
units.verify: 逐門標註下車、上車與關門事件，檢查樓梯附近門組是否偏慢，再以各門最大完成時間對照整列停站時間。 以影片事件時間和門控紀錄交叉對時，分別統計交換完成與發車確認的尾端分布。~Annotate alighting, boarding and closure at each door, check slow groups near stairs, and compare the latest completion time with whole-train dwell. Synchronise video event times with door-controller logs and separately report the tails of exchange completion and departure confirmation.
units.failure: 行李卡門或乘客集中會讓均勻模型低估尾端；延長關門提示可能改善秩序，也可能提高固定停站時間。 先核對門口人數，避免把旅客集中誤診為門機速度下降。~Luggage obstruction and clustered passengers make the uniform model underestimate the tail; a longer closing warning may improve order while increasing the fixed dwell component. Check doorway demand before misdiagnosing passenger concentration as slower door machinery.
units.misconception: 每扇門的平均流率相同就能忽略乘客分布差異~Equal average door flow rates make passenger distribution irrelevant to dwell time.
units.practice: 將一半上車需求集中在四分之一車門，重算最慢門組；提出導引與月台配置改進並區分其對固定時間和交換時間的作用。 再以本單元 exchange 的對照值重算 dwell，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Concentrate half the demand at one quarter of the doors, recalculate the slowest group, and distinguish guidance changes affecting fixed time from those affecting exchange time. Also recalculate dwell for the alternative exchange value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 通訊延遲與位置陳舊量~Communication delay and stale position
units.title: 通訊延遲與位置陳舊量~Communication delay and stale position
units.mechanism: 移動列車在訊息傳遞期間繼續前進，最簡單的陳舊位置上界是速度乘延遲。封包延遲、遺失與時鐘偏差應分開，平均延遲不能代表最壞情況，也不能直接替代列車保護的安全論證。 傳輸時間不是訊息年齡的全部，排隊、重送及接收端處理也可能占主要比例。安全邏輯應明確定義逾時後的狀態；成功收到舊封包不能當成最新授權。 檢查循環運轉中授權資料到期如何影響後續列車。~A moving train advances while a message is in transit. Speed times delay gives the simplest stale-position bound. Packet delay, loss and clock bias must be separated; mean latency neither represents a worst case nor replaces a safety argument for train protection. Transmission time is not the entire message age; queueing, retransmission and receiver processing may dominate. Safety logic needs an explicit state after timeout. Successful receipt of an old packet is not equivalent to a fresh movement authority. Inspect how authority-data expiry affects following trains during circular operation.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：v=25 m/s; latency=0.312 s；計算：stale_distance=v*latency=7.8 m。敏感度：latency 單獨增加百分之十至 0.3432 s，其餘固定，結果為 8.58 m。模型邊界：固定速度且單次訊息延遲；未含加速度、連續遺失及協定重試。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: v=25 m/s; latency=0.312 s; calculation: stale_distance=v*latency=7.8 m. Sensitivity: latency, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 0.3432 s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 8.58 m. Model boundary: Constant speed and one delayed message; acceleration, consecutive losses and protocol retries are excluded.
units.verify: 以送出和接收兩端的同步時間戳量延遲分布，注入延遲及封包遺失，確認過期訊息被辨識而非繼續當成即時位置。 以發送與接收端同步時鐘核對端到端延遲，記錄重送次數、封包遺失及最長連續中斷。~Measure latency distribution using synchronised transmit and receive timestamps, inject delay and packet loss, and confirm stale messages are identified rather than treated as current position. Use synchronised sender and receiver clocks to check end-to-end delay, recording retries, packet loss and the longest continuous interruption.
units.failure: 時鐘漂移可能讓過期訊息被誤判為新資料；只測低負載網路會漏掉交接區、干擾和突發流量造成的延遲尾端。 先檢查序號與時間戳，避免把重播封包誤認為狀態恢復。~Clock drift can make stale data appear fresh; low-load tests miss latency tails caused by handover, interference and burst traffic. Check sequence numbers and timestamps before interpreting a replayed packet as state recovery.
units.misconception: 平均網路延遲很低就足以證明所有控制訊息都及時到達~A low average network delay proves that every control message arrives on time.
units.practice: 把速度與延遲各提高一成，比較位置陳舊量；設計含連續遺失的重播案例，列出接收端需要保留的時間與序號資訊。 再以本單元 latency 的對照值重算 stale_distance，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Increase speed and delay separately, compare stale distance, and design a replay with consecutive losses listing the timestamps and sequence information required at the receiver. Also recalculate stale_distance for the alternative latency value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 里程融合與不確定度~Position fusion and uncertainty
units.title: 里程融合與不確定度~Position fusion and uncertainty
units.mechanism: 獨立位置感測器可用變異數倒數加權，但只有誤差不相關且偏差已校正時，融合後不確定度才按公式下降。輪徑誤差和共同地圖偏差可能讓多個通道一起偏移，不能靠增加感測器數量消除。 兩個獨立無偏估計的資訊量可以相加，較小變異數應獲較大權重。共同偏差不會被這種融合消除，相關性也會破壞公式；較小標準差只能表示宣告模型下的精密度。 在重複繞圈情境中檢查定位偏差是否獲參考點校正。~Independent position measurements can be weighted by inverse variance, but uncertainty decreases as predicted only when errors are uncorrelated and biases have been corrected. Wheel-diameter error and shared map bias can shift multiple channels together, so merely adding sensors does not remove systematic error. Information from two independent unbiased estimates can be combined, assigning greater weight to smaller variance. Shared bias is not removed by this fusion, and correlation invalidates the expression. Smaller standard deviation represents precision only under the declared statistical model. Check whether localisation bias is corrected at reference points during repeated circuits.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：s1=4.16 m; s2=2 m；計算：sigma=(1/(1/s1**2+1/s2**2))**0.5=1.802505 m。敏感度：s1 單獨增加百分之十至 4.576 m，其餘固定，結果為 1.832609 m。模型邊界：零均值獨立高斯誤差；不含共同偏差與完整性風險。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: s1=4.16 m; s2=2 m; calculation: sigma=(1/(1/s1**2+1/s2**2))**0.5=1.802505 m. Sensitivity: s1, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 4.576 m, with all other inputs fixed, gives 1.832609 m. Model boundary: Independent zero-mean Gaussian errors; common bias and integrity risk are excluded.
units.verify: 以獨立已知控制點比較融合前後殘差，逐段檢查偏差及相關性，並故意遮蔽一個感測器觀察降級行為。 以外部參考位置核對兩感測器殘差，檢查平均偏差及相關係數，再比較融合後覆蓋範圍。~Compare pre-fusion and post-fusion residuals at independently surveyed points, check bias and correlation by segment, and mask one sensor to inspect degraded operation. Check both sensor residuals against an external position reference, examine mean bias and correlation, and compare coverage after fusion.
units.failure: 共用錯誤地圖會讓兩個感測器看似一致卻都錯；錯把相關訊號當獨立會使報告的置信區間過窄。 若兩感測器共用錯誤基準，融合後仍會保持共同偏差。~A shared wrong map can make two sensors agree while both are wrong; treating correlated signals as independent produces an overconfident interval. If both sensors share a wrong reference, the fused result retains the common bias.
units.misconception: 兩個定位來源彼此一致就能保證定位沒有共同偏差~Agreement between two position sources guarantees absence of common bias.
units.practice: 建立獨立誤差與共同偏差兩組資料，對比融合結果，指出哪一種誤差需要外部控制點才能發現。 再以本單元 s1 的對照值重算 sigma，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Construct independent-error and common-bias datasets, compare their fused results, and identify the error requiring an external control point for detection. Also recalculate sigma for the alternative s1 value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 垂直動線有效輸送率~Vertical circulation throughput
units.title: 垂直動線有效輸送率~Vertical circulation throughput
units.mechanism: 電扶梯的理論輸送率可由速度、梯級間距及每級人數估算，實際值還受入口遲疑、行李和站立習慣限制。多台設備不一定能線性相加，因為共用入口或出口可能先形成瓶頸。 階梯間距與速度決定理論階梯通過率，每階占用率則把機械運動轉成載客量。旅客猶豫、行李及出口壅塞會降低實際通過率，不能以理論值直接證明疏散能力。 把深層車站垂直移動與出口步行時間分開量測。~Escalator theoretical throughput follows speed, step pitch and occupants per step. Hesitation, luggage and standing habits limit actual use. Several escalators do not necessarily add linearly when a shared entrance or exit becomes the earlier bottleneck. Step pitch and speed determine theoretical step passage, while occupancy per step converts mechanical motion into passenger flow. Hesitation, luggage and blocked exits reduce delivery, so the theoretical rate cannot directly demonstrate evacuation capacity. Measure deep-station vertical travel separately from walking to the exit.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：speed=0.52 m/s; pitch=0.4 m/step; occupants=1.2 persons/step；計算：throughput=3600*speed/pitch*occupants=5616 persons/hour。敏感度：speed 單獨增加百分之十至 0.572 m/s，其餘固定，結果為 6177.6 persons/hour。模型邊界：穩定速度和平均梯級占用；不含出入口匯流與無障礙替代路徑。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: speed=0.52 m/s; pitch=0.4 m/step; occupants=1.2 persons/step; calculation: throughput=3600*speed/pitch*occupants=5616 persons/hour. Sensitivity: speed, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 0.572 m/s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 6177.6 persons/hour. Model boundary: Steady speed and mean step occupancy; entrance merging and accessible alternative routes are excluded.
units.verify: 逐時段計數入口和出口，記錄空梯級比例與行李比例，並在共用平台量隊列長度，避免把額定值當現場值。 核對階梯間距與帶速，以入口及出口計數比較乘客流量，另記停頓和空階比例。~Count entrance and exit flow by interval, record empty-step and luggage fractions, and measure the shared-landing queue rather than substituting rated throughput. Verify step pitch and belt speed, compare entry and exit passenger counts, and separately record stoppages and empty-step proportions.
units.failure: 出口暫停會造成回堵並影響整段動線；一台設備停機時，另一台的入口可能無法吸收全部轉移人流。 出口堵塞時提高帶速可能加劇累積，需先檢查出口容量。~A pause at the exit causes spillback through the circulation path; when one escalator is unavailable, the other entrance may not accept all diverted passengers. Increasing belt speed can worsen accumulation at a blocked outlet; inspect outlet capacity first.
units.misconception: 兩台電扶梯的實際總輸送率必定等於單台額定值兩倍~Two escalators necessarily deliver twice the rated throughput of one escalator.
units.practice: 比較一台停機與出口縮窄兩種情境，畫出瓶頸位置，提出電梯與樓梯的替代動線並記錄不同旅客所需時間。 再以本單元 speed 的對照值重算 throughput，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Compare one failed escalator with a narrowed exit, map the bottleneck, and propose lift and stair alternatives while recording journey times for different passenger needs. Also recalculate throughput for the alternative speed value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 隧道換氣與稀釋時間~Tunnel air exchange and dilution time
units.title: 隧道換氣與稀釋時間~Tunnel air exchange and dilution time
units.mechanism: 完全混合空間的濃度在定風量清除下呈指數衰減，體積除以風量給出特徵時間。真實隧道存在分層、死角及列車活塞風，因此這個模型只適合示範稀釋量級，不能直接用作火災避難判定。 完全混合且污染源已停止時，濃度以指數衰減；剩餘比例必須介於零與一。換氣率是流量除以容積，清除時間還依目標濃度而變，不能把一次換氣直接當成全部清除。 比較深層站有效通風容積與換氣率的單位定義。~A perfectly mixed volume under constant clean-air flow exhibits exponential concentration decay, with volume divided by flow as the time constant. Real tunnels contain layering, stagnant regions and train-induced piston flow. This model illustrates dilution scale and cannot establish fire evacuation tenability. For perfect mixing after the source stops, concentration decays exponentially and the remaining fraction lies between zero and one. Air-change rate is flow divided by volume, while clearance time also depends on target concentration. One air change does not mean complete removal. Compare effective deep-station ventilation volume with the units used for air-change rate.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：volume=3000 m^3; flow=26 m^3/s; remaining=0.1 1；計算：dilution_time=-volume/flow*log(remaining)=265.6829 s。敏感度：flow 單獨增加百分之十至 28.6 m^3/s，其餘固定，結果為 241.5299 s。模型邊界：完全混合且污染源已停止；不含煙層、熱浮力與火災成長。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: volume=3000 m^3; flow=26 m^3/s; remaining=0.1 1; calculation: dilution_time=-volume/flow*log(remaining)=265.6829 s. Sensitivity: flow, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 28.6 m^3/s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 241.5299 s. Model boundary: Perfect mixing after source removal; smoke layers, buoyancy and fire growth are excluded.
units.verify: 用非危險示蹤試驗在不同高度與距離採樣，量測實際風量並檢查濃度衰減是否符合單一指數。 以安全示蹤氣體衰減核對時間常數，多點量測濃度並保留門狀態，檢查是否存在未停止源。~Use a harmless tracer test with samples at several heights and distances, measure actual airflow, and check whether one exponential describes the decay. Check the time constant with safe tracer decay, measure concentration at multiple points, retain door states, and check for a continuing source.
units.failure: 死角可能在平均濃度下降後仍維持高濃度；風機反轉或風門錯位也會改變流路，不能只用風機啟動回饋判斷通風。 風機有轉不代表有效稀釋，需查風道旁通和持續污染源。~Stagnant pockets may remain concentrated after the average falls; reversed fans or misplaced dampers alter flow paths, so a running-status signal alone cannot verify ventilation. A running fan does not prove effective dilution; inspect bypass and continuing contaminant sources.
units.misconception: 風機已經啟動就能證明隧道每一處濃度同樣下降~A running fan proves concentration falls equally at every point in the tunnel.
units.practice: 對兩種風量計算達到同一殘餘比例的時間，加入一個不完全混合死角，說明量測配置如何發現模型失配。 再以本單元 flow 的對照值重算 dilution_time，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Calculate time to one residual fraction at two airflows, add a poorly mixed pocket, and explain how sensor placement can reveal model mismatch. Also recalculate dilution_time for the alternative flow value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 沉陷差與軌道坡折~Differential settlement and track kink
units.title: 沉陷差與軌道坡折~Differential settlement and track kink
units.mechanism: 均勻沉陷主要改變高程，短距離差異沉陷則改變軌道坡度和車輪動態荷載。兩端高差除以基長只給平均坡度，無法描述局部尖峰；需要多點剖面才能辨認曲率與變形長度。 相同端點坡度可以對應完全不同的中間形狀，因此坡度不能單獨表示軌道曲率。測點間距必須小於欲辨認的變形尺度，並將高程誤差相對於基長傳遞到坡度結果。 對施工鄰近建築建立多點沉陷剖面與穩定外部基準。~Uniform settlement mainly changes elevation, whereas differential settlement over a short distance alters track slope and dynamic wheel loading. End-to-end difference divided by baseline gives only an average gradient, not a local peak. A spatial profile is needed to identify curvature and deformation length. Identical endpoint gradient can hide very different intermediate shapes, so gradient alone cannot describe track curvature. Survey spacing must resolve the deformation length scale, and elevation uncertainty must be propagated relative to the baseline into the reported gradient. Build multipoint settlement profiles and a stable external datum for buildings near construction.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：drop=0.01248 m; baseline=20 m；計算：gradient=1000*drop/baseline=0.624 mm/m。敏感度：drop 單獨增加百分之十至 0.013728 m，其餘固定，結果為 0.6864 mm/m。模型邊界：小變形平均坡度；不計車軌耦合動力或容許軌道幾何。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: drop=0.01248 m; baseline=20 m; calculation: gradient=1000*drop/baseline=0.624 mm/m. Sensitivity: drop, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 0.013728 m, with all other inputs fixed, gives 0.6864 mm/m. Model boundary: Small-deformation average gradient; vehicle-track dynamics and permissible geometry limits are excluded.
units.verify: 採用同一穩定水準基點反覆量測，保留溫度和施工時間，利用多點高程剖面區分整段平移、坡折與量測基點漂移。 重複觀測同一測點並做閉合檢核，以另一穩定基準核對零點，報告高差與基長各自誤差。~Repeat surveys against one stable datum, retain temperature and construction timing, and use multipoint profiles to separate translation, kinks and datum drift. Repeat identical points with closure checks, verify zero against another stable reference, and report separate errors for elevation difference and baseline.
units.failure: 基點本身下沉會讓全段看似正常；只量端點又會漏掉中間沉陷槽，兩種情況均可低估輪軌衝擊。 高差異常需先查基點，不能立刻推定路基局部下沉。~A settling datum can hide movement of the whole section, and endpoint-only measurement misses an intermediate trough; both may understate wheel-rail impact. An unusual level difference requires a datum check before inferring local earthwork settlement.
units.misconception: 兩端高程相同就能證明兩點之間沒有差異沉陷~Equal endpoint elevations prove there is no differential settlement between them.
units.practice: 構造端點相同但中間下陷的剖面，與直線坡度模型比較；提出足以辨識沉陷槽寬度的測點間距與複測頻率。 再以本單元 drop 的對照值重算 gradient，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Construct a profile with equal endpoints and an intermediate trough, compare it with a straight-gradient model, and propose spacing and repeat intervals able to resolve the trough. Also recalculate gradient for the alternative drop value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 注漿量與空隙體積~Grout volume and void account
units.title: 注漿量與空隙體積~Grout volume and void account
units.mechanism: 填充空隙所需漿量先由幾何空隙體積估算，再考慮損失與材料體積變化。注入量大不代表填充完整，因為漿液可能沿裂縫流失；壓力、流量與返漿紀錄必須互相對照。 此算例把空隙視為長乘寬乘均勻厚度的薄層，再乘假定餘量。它不是完整圓環幾何；若用於環隙局部展開，須說明薄層近似，且不能由注入總量推論填充均勻。 以局部展開的薄層空隙估算灌漿量，區分理論體積與實注量。~Required grout begins with geometric void volume and allowances for loss and volume change. A large injected volume does not prove complete filling because grout can escape through cracks. Pressure, flow and returns must be interpreted together to distinguish filling from loss. This example treats a void as length times width times uniform thickness with an assumed allowance. It is not full annular geometry. A locally unwrapped annulus requires an explicit thin-layer approximation, and total injection does not establish uniform filling. Estimate grout for a locally unwrapped thin void, distinguishing theoretical from injected volume.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：length=20 m; width=2.5 m; gap=0.0416 m; allowance=1.15 1；計算：grout_volume=length*width*gap*allowance=2.392 m^3。敏感度：gap 單獨增加百分之十至 0.04576 m，其餘固定，結果為 2.6312 m^3。模型邊界：均勻幾何間隙與假設損失係數；不指定注漿壓力或現地工法。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: length=20 m; width=2.5 m; gap=0.0416 m; allowance=1.15 1; calculation: grout_volume=length*width*gap*allowance=2.392 m^3. Sensitivity: gap, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 0.04576 m, with all other inputs fixed, gives 2.6312 m^3. Model boundary: Uniform geometric gap and assumed loss allowance; no injection pressure or field procedure is specified.
units.verify: 核對批次體積、流量計及返漿量，將注入壓力與時間曲線同步，完成後以獨立檢測確認空隙分布。 校對泵送流量計與漿液批次密度，分開累計注入、回流及廢棄量，核對薄層幾何尺寸。~Reconcile batch volume, flow meter and returns, synchronise injection pressure over time, and verify void distribution afterward using an independent inspection method. Calibrate pump flow and batch density, separately total injection, return and waste volumes, and verify the thin-layer dimensions.
units.failure: 漏失會讓注入體積增加而空隙仍未填滿，局部封堵又會使壓力快速上升；僅憑達到預算漿量不能驗收。 達到預算漿量不等於填滿空隙，須查回流和漏失。~Loss can increase injected volume while leaving a void unfilled, and local blockage can raise pressure rapidly; reaching the budgeted volume is not acceptance evidence. Reaching the budgeted grout volume does not prove void filling; inspect returns and losses.
units.misconception: 注入漿量超過幾何空隙體積就能證明沒有殘留空洞~Injecting more than the geometric void volume proves that no void remains.
units.practice: 比較正常填充與沿裂縫漏失兩組流量壓力紀錄，做體積收支並提出能辨識兩者的獨立檢測。 再以本單元 gap 的對照值重算 grout_volume，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Compare flow-pressure records for normal filling and crack leakage, build a volume balance, and propose an independent inspection that distinguishes the two. Also recalculate grout_volume for the alternative gap value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 並聯備援與共同原因~Parallel redundancy and common cause
units.title: 並聯備援與共同原因~Parallel redundancy and common cause
units.mechanism: 兩個獨立元件只要有一個成功即可服務時，系統失效機率等於兩者失效機率相乘。但共用電源、軟體或環境會破壞獨立假設，備援數量增加不能自動證明整體風險按平方下降。 獨立失效機率相乘只在共同原因可忽略時成立。共用機房、電源、時鐘或軟體缺陷會使冗餘失去預期效果；應把獨立事件與共同事件分成不同邏輯項。 檢查環線控制備援是否仍受同一供電或機房事件影響。~When either of two independent components can serve the demand, system failure probability is the product of their failure probabilities. Shared power, software or environment breaks independence. More redundant components therefore do not automatically prove a squared reduction in overall risk. Multiplying failure probabilities requires negligible common causes. Shared rooms, power, clocks or software defects can defeat expected redundancy. Represent independent events and common events as separate logical terms rather than silently combining them. Check whether ring-control redundancy remains exposed to one supply or equipment-room event.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：q1=0.0208 1; q2=0.03 1；計算：joint_failure=q1*q2=0.000624 1。敏感度：q1 單獨增加百分之十至 0.02288 1，其餘固定，結果為 0.0006864 1。模型邊界：同一時間窗內獨立失效且切換完美；不含共同原因與切換失敗。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: q1=0.0208 1; q2=0.03 1; calculation: joint_failure=q1*q2=0.000624 1. Sensitivity: q1, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 0.02288 1, with all other inputs fixed, gives 0.0006864 1. Model boundary: Independent failures in one time window with perfect switching; common causes and switch failure are excluded.
units.verify: 畫出供電、網路、冷卻和軟體版本的依賴圖，逐一驗證切換功能；以故障注入確認另一通道可承接完整需求。 列出兩通道共用的實體與軟體資源，分開注入單路故障及共因故障，核對失效狀態。~Map dependencies in power, networking, cooling and software versions, verify switching, and use fault injection to confirm the surviving channel can carry the full demand. List physical and software resources shared by both channels, inject individual and common-cause faults separately, and verify resulting failure states.
units.failure: 兩台設備接在同一配電盤可能被一次故障同時切斷；過載備援也可能在接手後立即失效。 兩個盒子不等於兩個獨立通道，須核對共用依賴。~Two devices on one distribution board can be lost together, and an undersized backup can fail immediately after taking over. Two boxes do not imply two independent channels; inspect their shared dependencies.
units.misconception: 只要設備數量變成兩台失效機率就必定平方降低~Doubling equipment count necessarily squares down the failure probability.
units.practice: 在獨立模型加入一個共同原因機率，對比結果，列出可用物理隔離與不同依賴路徑降低的風險。 再以本單元 q1 的對照值重算 joint_failure，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Add one common-cause probability to the independent model, compare the result, and identify risks reduced by physical separation and distinct dependencies. Also recalculate joint_failure for the alternative q1 value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
